evidence.basis: Reusable native compounds, consumed substitutions, displaced controls and retained source pairs
evidence.note: 3 column placements × 2 row placements; alternate reflected compound units

evidence.name: Curves and band occupancy
evidence.basis: Actual polynomial curves and corresponding side profiles
evidence.note: The curved silhouettes come from native control-word interpolation. These are chosen lateral profiles, not exact normal offsets.

evidence.name: Seam questions
evidence.basis: Actual exposed end ports, positions, tangents and side correspondences
evidence.note: A visually continuous tile edge does not create shared site identity. Open or opposed seam evidence stays available.

evidence.name: Main colour intentions
evidence.basis: Separate desired contrast order and published ordinal observations
evidence.note: Main chain versus motif contrast, accent versus its host fill, edge versus fill, and an unresolved perceptual read. Compatibility 53/64 is an authored aggregate channel, not beauty probability.

evidence.name: Alternate colour focus
evidence.basis: Same geometry and identities; another focus/paint assignment
evidence.note: The alternate asks for motif emphasis. A colour proxy can disagree with that intention; the discrepancy remains visible.

evidence.name: Flat-paint counterexample
evidence.basis: Identical geometry with role colours collapsed to the ground
evidence.note: The negative control tests the declared contrast relations rather than geometric or aesthetic correctness.

evidence.name: Jones guidance
evidence.outcome: 37 propositions in the consulted original; selected colour guidance applied
evidence.basis: 14, 16, 22 and 28–34, with geometric groundwork and tangential growth
evidence.note: Strong accents over quieter masses, readable parts and separating edges are intentions. Historical pigment ratios and architectural recession are not universal flat-image laws.
